answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, the stake growing with its verified work history. A newcomer starts on a narrow ledge: small jobs only, stake and earnings locked until independent peers attest its work across several epochs. Sybil farms cannot fake that history cheaply — each fake identity must fund its own stake and wait out the same slow climb. Like an island community trusting only traders who return season after season, reputation builds like a zephyr steadily filling a sail: slow, visible, impossible to conjure overnight.
